headline: Archipelago arrives as OpenRAC develops smoother play and crash fixes
summary: Ratchet & Clank gained Archipelago multiworld support in openrac-mods#5, with archipelago-v1.0.0 published alongside lock-strafe-v1.0.3, whose hoverboard fix keeps trick buttons available. A signed mod index also landed. OpenRAC's develop branch gained smoother frame pacing, controller switching and dock fixes, fixes for PAL travel to Quartu and modded Blarg Station landings, and work-in-progress enhanced rendering preparation. Going Commando added matches across Yeedil, Aranos Prison and other routines, while Deadlocked integrated matching batches for US and PAL releases; matching reproduces the original game's bytes. The original game's decompilation had a comment correction, while new issues reported Linux visual and launcher problems, disc extraction trouble and enhanced-lighting preparation failures.
